1879064083.name: Spider's Guile (Melee)
1879064083.desc: This fellowship skill does minor direct melee damage to your target, then more damage over time and can contribute to fellowship manoeuvres.

1879064339.name: Touch and Go
1879064339.desc: Lighten your step, improving your Evade and your Defence.\n\nUsing this skill will not break Stealth.

1879115155.name: Shadowed Heart
1879115155.desc: Increases incoming healing by 200% as well as increasing in and out of combat health regeneration by 8 for 120 seconds. The monster has been granted a glimpse into Amarthiel's dark heart and rejoices.

1879136787.name: Headshot
1879136787.desc: You take careful aim and loose your arrow.\n\n<rgb=#00ff00>Ignores 30% of your target's mitigations</rgb>

1879190675.name: Steed of Night
1879190675.desc: Black as the night, this unique looking horse has 250 Morale and is as fast as a reputation mount. The horse has the added benefit of not knocking you off immediately when critically hit by an attacker.

1879198355.name: Friend of the Wilds (Swamp-guardian)
1879198355.desc: Summons a Bog-guardian companion.\n\nThe Bog-guardian excels at dealing damage from range.

1879205907.name: Nimble Redhorn-goat
1879205907.desc: As a great ally of the Iron Garrison Miners, one can expect access to their most well-trained and quickest goats.  This goat can move as fast as most horses.

1879232403.name: Shield Tactics
1879232403.desc: Impressive shield movements increase your defences.\n\n<rgb=#00FFDD>This Gambit grants immunity to stuns.</rgb>

1879239571.name: Flay Open
1879239571.desc: You draw back your blade to carve a shallow gash through your enemy's flesh.

1879244563.name: Ranged Celebration of Skill
1879244563.desc: An impressive movement that restores a significant amount of morale.\n\n<rgb=#FF7700>Using will restore this skill to Battle Memory.</rgb>

1879259923.name: Trick: Impugn Character
1879259923.desc: You strike out at your foe with a cunning trick.

1879260051.name: Swift Bow: Star-light
1879260051.desc: Loose two missiles in rapid succession.\n\nArrows inflict Light damage.

conditionalEffects.description: Swift Bow has a chance to make Merciful Shot available.

1879260307.name: Radiant Blast
1879260307.desc: You hurl a lens toward your target distracting and potentially dismounting them. The glimmering light will attract a murder of crows to hamper the target's movement once the distraction dissipates.\n\n<rgb=#ff6600>This skill cannot be used on a target under the effects of 'Murder of Crows' the movement reducing effect applied by Radiant Burst.</rgb>

1879270547.name: Barrage of Light 2
1879270547.desc: A quick attack that deals more damage each time it is used.

conditionalEffects.description: Ranged Focus Spenders increase your Ranged Damage until your next Ranged Focus Builder.

1879271571.name: Ring of Fire
1879271571.desc: An attack leaving a flaming circle upon the ground that enemies fear to enter.

conditionalEffects.description:
After using a Lightning Skill, your Frost Skills will slow enemies.

After using a Fire Skill, your Frost Skills will make enemies Brittle, increasing their incoming Critical Chance.

1879275155.name: Triple Trap
1879275155.desc: Places a trap to root the enemy.\n\nTrap remains for 60 seconds after being placed.

1879422227.name: Aggressive Posture
1879422227.desc: Adopt an aggressive posture, increasing offensive capability at the cost of defence.\nOnly one Posture may be active at a time.

1879457555.name: Shield Up
1879457555.desc: Briefly raise your shield to increase your defences.\n\n<rgb=#FF7700>Using will restore this skill to Battle Memory.</rgb>

1879466259.name: Step Back
1879466259.desc:
Create space with a step back.

<rgb=#FF7700>Swordplay:
 Disengage gains a heal.
 Riposte will enrage your target.</rgb>

1879475987.name: Guide to Halrax
1879475987.desc: Returns you and your Fellowship to Halrax in the Shield Isles.\n\nThis skill is easily interrupted.

1879483667.name: Battle-shout
1879483667.desc: An attack that triggers a Battle-readied State, enabling you to deal more damage.

conditionalEffects.description: Critical Events Increase your Melee Damage by 3%.
Critical Events Increase your Melee Damage by 6%.

1879488019.name: Friend of the Wilds (Gourd-guardian)
1879488019.desc: Summons a Bog-guardian companion.\n\nThe Bog-guardian excels at dealing damage from range.

1879495315.name: Memory of Triumph
1879495315.desc: A Memory of Triumph can be used to inspire an ally to greater feats on the battle-field.

1879508755.name: Sail to Sul Madásh
1879508755.desc: Navigate to Sul Madásh in Adagím in Mûr Ghala with nearby fellows.

1879521299.name: Battle-worn Worm
1879521299.desc: Summons a fierce battle-worn worm to accompany you on your travels.
